title: Pan-Seared Norwegian Dumplings with Garlic and Light Broth
description: A simple and flavorful dish originating from Norway, dumplings are a staple food in Scandinavian cuisine. This recipe highlights the tender Norwegian dumplings, served in a light and savory broth.

ingredients.name: Norwegian dumplings
ingredients.notes: available in most Scandinavian grocery stores

instructions: Heat the fatty in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and sauté for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the Norwegian dumplings to the skillet and cook until golden brown on all sides (about 5 minutes).
Transfer the dumplings to a large serving dish.
Pour in the light broth and bring to a simmer.
Cook for 5-7 minutes or until the dumplings are cooked through.
Garnish with tender parsley and serve hot.
